included: Reachable commit history of allowed_signers in vaidt/aura-specification
Tree of the Genesis commit parent

limitations: Repository chronology does not establish the exact time a private key created a signature.
Absence of allowed_signers in the inspected parent tree does not prove no independent trust anchor existed elsewhere.
A later allow-list can be used as the verifier's key input but does not itself demonstrate antecedent constitutional competence.
